core_achievements.evidence_as_hero: Physical observed satellite changes visually dominate across all views. Multi-spectral composites, 4-epoch crop galleries, and true pixel subtractions are rendered directly from Zarr.
core_achievements.air_gapped_gis_styling: Completely eliminated external OpenStreetMap network tile requests (tile.openstreetmap.org) which were displaying irrelevant third-party street/city labels. Replaced with dark label-free GIS tiles (CartoDB dark_nolabels) and local GeoPackage vector features, eliminating all place-name confusion.
core_achievements.map_lifecycle_stabilization: Fixed re-render thrashing where inline callback functions and whole-store subscriptions triggered continuous map destruction and re-initialization on mouse movements and zooms. Vectors now load immediately with zero zoom/pan glitching.
core_achievements.interactive_3d_lexcube: Created functional 3D Space-Time Earth Observation Data Cube with 3 visible orthogonal planes (Top XxY, Front XxZ, Right YxZ), 3-axis cut slicing across time/bands/northing/easting, Viridis colormap, and mouse orbit drag controls.
core_achievements.dedicated_raster_viewer: Added dedicated /raster route with location presets (Pallikaranai Wetland, Red Hills, Chembarambakkam, Chennai Port, Adyar River), band combination suite (RGB, CIR, SWIR, NDVI, NDMI, NDBI), Raster <-> Vector visual switcher with opacity slider, pixel coordinate sampler, and instant 'ADD TO DOSSIER' action.
core_achievements.final_retrieval_report: Integrated 'GENERATE FINAL RETRIEVAL REPORT' action in Discover view that automatically synthesizes search findings and displays a comprehensive Mission Intelligence Brief in Reports & Dossier view, with multi-format export (GeoJSON, CSV, JSON, Print).
